decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that builds on the firm’s core postpress portfolio and remained on its own page in 2024, it fits the move toward integrated automated workflows and is cheap enough to keep while market potential continues to resolve.

As a close-to-core folding add-on with a cited customer use case and continued website presence in 2024, it appears to have practical traction and low carrying cost, so the option value of keeping it exceeds the benefit of dropping it.
